description: Bulk history for one coin, one metric per call, in pages: 'price' (OHLCV candles, spot or perp), 'open_interest' (market-wide aggregate USD), 'funding' (OI-weighted rate, %/8h and annualized) or 'liquidations' (market-wide long/short USD per bucket). Returns up to 'limit' rows (default 200, max 1000) at or before 'end' (default now), oldest first, as compact columns + rows; pass the returned nextEndMs as 'end' to fetch the page before it, and 'start' to stop there. Reach: price is full venue history (Binance spot from 2017, futures from 2019) at 1m–1w; derivatives come from CoinGlass at 4h (about 180 days back), 6h/8h/12h (about 360 days) or 1d/1w (back to 2020) — use 1d for anything older than six months. The newest row may still be forming (newestForming). Use this to pull history; for a read of what is happening now, use the derivatives_* and research_* tools.

end.description: Latest time to include: ISO-8601 or Unix ms. Default now. Pass nextEndMs here to page back.

interval.description: Bucket size. Price: 1m–1w except 6h/8h, default 1d. Derivatives: 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d or 1w; default 4h (funding 8h).

market.description: Price only: spot (default) or perpetual candles.

start.description: Earliest time to include: ISO-8601 (UTC if no offset) or Unix ms. Paging stops here.

name: market_history

columns.description: Names of each row's cells; the first is timeMs (bucket open, Unix ms)

earliestAvailableMs.description: Set when 'end' was before the plan's history edge for this interval

endMs.description: The page's end bound, Unix ms

newestForming.description: Newest row's bucket is still open; the vendor rewrites it until it closes

nextEndMs.description: Pass as 'end' for the page before this one; null when this page reached 'start' or the series' beginning

rows.description: Oldest first; each row is [timeMs, ...values] in column order; null where the source has no value

title: Market History
